dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A Tent Tortoise? That shouldn't be here at all!

dialogues.speaker: Dahlia
dialogues.text: Wow, I've never seen such a large turtle in my life.

dialogues.speaker: Dahlia
dialogues.text: There was a time, back when I was little, when almost every child in Mondstadt had a turtle as a pet. It was quite the trend.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh yeah! Jean and Diluc mentioned that a long time ago.

dialogues.speaker: Dahlia
dialogues.text: I had one too, of course.

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: Quite the hassle to take care of — small pets like that always are.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, uh... No, of course not!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What should we do with this Tent Tortoise?

dialogues.speaker: Dahlia
dialogues.text: I could bring it back to the Church and raise it. It can stay behind the Cathedral — I'll even build it a pool.

dialogues.speaker: Dahlia
dialogues.text: Can't be too hard to raise, right? It looks like a tough cookie.

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: ...Not happening. The next thing you know, you'll have an invasive species on your hands.

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: Just tell that mage to put it back where she found it.

dialogues.speaker: Dahlia
dialogues.text: Can't be too hard to raise, right? It looks like a tough cookie.

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: ...Not happening. The next thing you know, you'll have an invasive species on your hands.
